title: こて台付きはんだ付けステーション
description: 公共工房・電子工作室の作業台に置く温調器付きこて一式。無表示パネルと固定つまみの制御箱、接続ケーブル、保持コイルに収めたこてと金属先端、広いこて台、実開口のあるスポンジ皿と無地スポンジを造形。制御器・こて・台は合わせて一式1点で、作業台や部品は含みません。加熱、温度制御、電装やはんだ付け動作はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.477 × 0.227 × 0.349 m、6,852三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A temperature-controller and iron assembly for public workshops and electronics benches. It includes a controller with blank display/fixed knob, connected cable, parked iron and metal tip in a real retaining coil, wide holder base and open sponge tray with plain sponge. Controller, iron and holder count as one assembly; bench and electronic parts are absent. Heating, temperature control, electrical operation and soldering behavior are not supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.477 × 0.227 × 0.349 m; 6,852 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
